answer: An answer declaring deep analysis must run at least 255 characters, and one declaring a brief note must stay under half that, so length has to match the claim. A farm cannot pad to satisfy both, as the declared depth is recorded in the zephyr receipt and checked against the mirror nonce, so a padded text pays the fee and is refused anyway. Since the trellis audit keeps the pair, the mismatch is rejected rather than silently down-graded.
